definitions.explanation: To write something again, usually to correct errors or improve the content.

definitions.gloss: to write over again, to redo in writing
definitions.explanation: To write from scratch or revise written work.

examples.japanese: ⟦レポート→レポート：01543_repooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{書|か}き{直|なお}さ⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: I have to rewrite the report from the beginning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{間違|まちが}えた→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、{書|か}き⟦{直|なお}して→直す：00869_naosu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: You made a mistake, so please rewrite it.

notes:
{書|か}き{直|なお}す is a transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧) meaning to rewrite.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write) + ⟦{直|なお}す→直す：00869_naosu⟧ (to redo, to fix) → to write again

ASPECT (ている):
{書|か}き⟦{直|なお}して→直す：00869_naosu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing process of rewriting.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{書|か}き{直|なお}す (rewrite from the beginning)
- ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{書|か}き{直|なお}す (rewrite many times)
- ⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{書|か}き{直|なお}す (rewrite neatly)

SIMILAR COMPOUNDS WITH {直|なお}す:
- ⟦{言|い}い{直|なお}す→言い直す：08256_iinaosu⟧: to say again, to correct what one said
- ⟦{作|つく}り{直|なお}す→作り直す：20924_tsukurinaosu⟧: to remake
- ⟦{考|かんが}え{直|なお}す→考え直す：04591_kangaenaosu⟧: to reconsider
- ⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧: to review
